slides.title: The childhood vision problem
slides.text:
1. THE PROBLEM IN INDIA
Why Catching Childhood Eye Problems Early Saves Sight
When one eye is weak or slightly turned (lazy eye or squint), a young child’s brain gradually ignores that eye. If missed in early childhood, sight
loss can become permanent.
260M
Children Under 14 in India
Every young child needs early eye alignment
& movement checks before starting primary
school.
5–10M
Affected Children (2–4%)
Live with amblyopia (“lazy eye”) or strabismus
(eye misalignment / squint) — often without
noticing.
90%
Treatable Before Age 7–8
Simple glasses, patching, or eye therapy work
best while the brain’s visual wiring is still
growing.
<10%
Screened Early Today
Over 9 out of 10 rural and low-income
children miss early screening during this
crucial window.
The Result: Thousands of children suffer lifelong, preventable vision loss simply because
an eye doctor check never reached them in time.

slides.title: Barriers to accessible observation
slides.text:
2. WHY CURRENT TOOLS FAIL
Three Real-World Barriers Leaving Kids Unscreened
Checking a 3-year-old’s eyes in a village Anganwadi is very different from testing an adult in a city hospital.
🏥
1. Costly Clinic Hardware (₹1–3
Lakhs)
Hospital photoscreeners and autorefractors cost
lakhs of rupees and require trained specialists.
They stay locked inside urban eye hospitals —
far away from village children.
• Zero availability in rural Anganwadis
• ~1 ophthalmologist per 40,000+ people
Impossible to scale to every school
🔤
2. Toddlers Can’t Read Letter
Charts
Most mobile screening apps simply display
letter charts (“E” or “C”) and ask the child to
point or press buttons.
• Ages 2–5 cannot read or match directions
• Kids hate covering one eye and get bored
Fails for pre-verbal young kids
☁
3. Internet & Child Privacy Risks
Community health centers often lack reliable
high-speed internet. Meanwhile, cloud apps
upload face photos or video online.
• Weak mobile data breaks cloud apps
• Parents fear facial recording & misuse
Fails offline & risks face data
💡  What India Actually Needs: ₹0 extra hardware · No reading needed · 100% offline privacy → NETRA-SCREEN

slides.title: Watching both eyes move together
slides.text:
4. HOW THE MEASUREMENT WORKS
Watching Both Eyes Move Together vs. One Frozen Snapshot
In clinics, a doctor moves a toy in front of a child to see if both eyes follow smoothly. NETRA-SCREEN automates that exact observation on a
phone.
TRADITIONAL STATIC CHECKS
Single Photo or Letter Board
Captures one frozen moment or asks kids to read letters. Can miss
eyes that wander or lag during smooth movement.
WHAT NETRA-SCREEN MEASURES IN PLAIN ENGLISH
1. Do both eyes move together?
Compares left & right eye timing and speed correlation.
2. Do both travel the same distance?
Checks symmetry between left and right iris range relative to eye
corners.
3. Can both hold steady on a spot?
Measures steadiness (fixation stability) during target holds after
jumps.
4 GUIDED MOVEMENTS + LIVE TRAJECTORY PLOT

slides.title: Privacy by design
slides.text:
8. ABSOLUTE PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Zero Videos Stored. 100% On-Device Control.
We handle children’s camera feeds with strict architectural safeguards — privacy is enforced in code, not just promises.
NO INTERNET PERMISSION · OFFLINE
ON-DEVICE MEDIAPIPE AI
AES-GCM KEYSTORE
🚫📷
Raw frames discarded immediately
📵100% On-Device & Offline
Zero cloud inference. Android asks for no Internet permission; the Web PWA blocks external
data connections strictly in browser headers.
🎞No Video or Photos Retained
Only anonymous eye-landmark numbers are processed in memory. Every raw camera frame is
discarded instantly after analysis.
🕶Hidden Camera Focus Option
Parents can hide the child’s self-view during tasks — helping kids stay calm and focused solely
on the butterfly, fish, or dot.
🔐AES-GCM Security & One-Tap Wipe
Optional saved summaries are encrypted inside Android Keystore. Parents can withdraw
consent and erase all local data in one tap.

slides.title: Responsible medical AI
slides.text:
9. RESPONSIBLE MEDICAL AI
Radical Honesty: A Pre-Screening Aid, Never a False Doctor
Great medical tech builds trust by clearly stating what it can and cannot do today. Safety rules are hard-coded into the software.
⚠
STRICT BOUNDARIES
What NETRA-SCREEN Is NOT
✕ Not a medical diagnosis tool: Cannot confirm or rule out amblyopia,
squint, glasses need, or any eye disease.
✕ Not a Hirschberg corneal reflex meter: Tracks landmark iris centers
relative to eye corners (separate pixel glint checks remain
experimental).
✕ Never says “Healthy / No Doctor Needed”: Safety mandate blocks
reassuring medical clearance in every language.
✕ No fake or simulated data in live runs: Missing frames stay marked
“Unavailable” instead of guessing.
Safety Gate: Release signing & clinical referral flags stay disabled until human
clinical trials complete.
🩺
SAFE HELPER WORKFLOW
What NETRA-SCREEN IS Today
✓ Objective pursuit & fixation recorder: Captures repeatable eye-
movement metrics and visual trajectory graphs offline.
✓ Research Triage Priority Guidance: Maps observed tracking metrics
into clear follow-up advice (Prompt Exam / Routine Check / Monitor /
Inconclusive Repeat).
✓ Clinical diagnostic release locked: Official clinical screening
distribution stays gated by code until independent hospital trials
conclude.
✓ Camera-free stage walkthrough & Eye Rest: Safe 20-20-20 breaks
and transparent demos for schools & judges.
Medical Principle: Every report advises seeing a qualified ophthalmologist
whenever any concern exists.

12. THE VISION & OUR ASK
Zero Extra Hardware. Infinite Grassroots Impact.
Software scales overnight when hardware already exists in every village health worker’s hand.
Kollam · Starting Hub
Schools · Anganwadis · ASHA Workers Across India
🔭  The Vision: Community Workers Empowered
Place NETRA-SCREEN directly into the smartphones already used by ASHA workers,
Anganwadi teachers, and school nurses — on Android or Web — with zero hardware
procurement cost.
💛  The Impact: Reaching the 90% Currently Missed
Enable rapid, joyful, zero-literacy pre-screening for millions of children under age 7–8 so
treatable lazy eye and misalignment are caught before school years.
🤝  Our Ask from YIP 9.0
We seek mentorship, multi-phone field testing access, Malayalam optometry review,
and hospital ophthalmology partnerships to run our Phase 2 usability & Phase 3 clinical
validation study.
“No child should lose preventable vision simply because of where they live.”
